name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Split.preimage_row_transform
title: Invertible row transforms of the matrix and the target leave the Gaussian preimage law unchanged
statement: For B (n x m), an n x n matrix T over Z_q with unit determinant and P (n x k): Trapdoor.preimage (T B) (T P) tau = Trapdoor.preimage B P tau.
